import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Plotting
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=df, ax=ax)

# Setting labels and title
ax.set_title('Transaction Amounts by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=14)
ax.legend(title='Is Fraud', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
